trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, obtuse U-shaped depression at the central vertical axis with an estimated pixel-angle between 130-150 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations with low pixel-amplitude (peaks < 5px) distributed continuously along the trailing boundary from the notch to the apices.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Macro-convex curves on both the left and right lobes, following a broad arc from the central notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips of both fluke lobes, corresponding to calcareous deposits or focal scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant white focal scarring or encrustations visible at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; overall dorsal surface shows a high-density black pixel distribution with minimal pigmentation variation.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-intensity pixel noise (water spray/occlusion) along the lower boundary of the fluke where it intersects the water line.
